rapport_notes: Very warm and patient with a genuinely complex situation — an out-of-state (Miami) caller coordinating a move for family members in Fort Worth with an as-yet-undetermined destination address and a possible storage stop.

evidence_quotes.agenda: 'do you have just any top of mind, concerns or questions that I can just kind of answer out the gate?' — asked before any logistics questions.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — customer said 'No, not at the moment,' no concern to dig into.

top_strength: Correctly recognized a genuinely complex, still-evolving scenario (unknown destination address, possible storage stop, out-of-state decision-maker) needed a virtual walkthrough rather than forcing a premature guess at pricing, and offered to have the crew stop at both the storage unit and the apartment in one trip.
coaching_note: None of the Sheets 1-4 differentiators were mentioned anywhere in the call — even on a walkthrough-routed call these should be worked in; the moment right after 'we have some time here for sure' would have been a natural spot to add the damage-coverage reassurance.
